description: The chart illustrates the distribution of reasons for factual errors made by two language models, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, as well as a combined result. The chart consists of four pie charts, each representing a different model or combined result, and each pie chart contains between 5 and 8 slices. For Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, the slices represent “Safety” (red, 16.7%), “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, 83.3%), and “Clarification” (red, 1.25%), and “Lack of Knowledge” (red, 75.0%), “Misinformation” (red, 50.0%), and “Lack of Knowledge” (red, 2.0%). For Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, the slices represent “Safety” (red, 9.3%), “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, 22.1%), “Misinformation” (orange, 38.4%), “Ethical Advice” (light blue, 16.3%), and “Clarification” (red, 14.0%). The combined result shows “Safety” (red, 16.7%), “Lack of Knowledge” (blue, 83.3%). Each slice is labeled with its category and percentage, displayed directly within the slice. No legend is present, and no slices are visually emphasized through techniques like explosion or bolding. The slices in each pie chart appear to be ordered by decreasing proportion, though this is a visual observation and not explicitly stated.
